propositions: Silent mutating verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, set-file-impact, etc.) make idempotent no-ops and successful writes indistinguishable on stdout, causing agents to issue spurious follow-up reads and retry logic on perceived failures.

Every verb in _WRITES_FULL and _LIFECYCLE must emit a single, uniform confirmation line on success (past-tense form with args summary and outcome detail) and 'no change: <reason>' on idempotent no-ops, both exiting 0, following modern CLI practice (kubectl/git/gh/terraform).

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must be normalized to the shared confirmation contract preserving all data they emit today (e.g. transition preserves UNBLOCKED ids datum).

Global --quiet/-q and --output/-o flags must be extracted at the top-level router before partition dispatch to cover all verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves, with --quiet suppressing text confirmations only and --output json producing a uniform mutation envelope.
The REDIRECT record emission in link must remain byte-identical on write and no-op paths (including under --quiet), printing exactly one result to stdout with no mixed text confirmation atop.

Seam return contracts consumed by other code (e.g. add_dependency's dict|None REDIRECT propagated to link_core and facade) must remain unchanged; confirmation signaling is derived from existing exposed contracts or added as a parallel channel.
